title: Had a Good Product, Downsided and Ruined It
text:
Updated review: I renewed my subscription after a break during the Covid pandemic. We have 3 purebred Maine Coons, the smallest is nearly 14 lbs, the largest is a17 lb male, still growing. The cats go-to favorite toys are still toys that initially came from this subscription service, which I gave 5 stars in my prior review. At that time, Meowbox deserved the high rating and praise. The toys were of better quality than ANY I could find online or at the store. I tried two cat toy subscription services to compare and found this one to be superior at the time. Not anymore. The toys are smaller and half are made from a rough fabric. My kitties really loved the soft felt/wool toys and the kickers. All the current toys were small and flimsy. I wouldn't leave them alone with some because they are so small they could be a choking hazard for my large cats. That's a shame, they had a really good product. I don't like to leave bad reviews, but if you have large kitties, these subscription services cater to small cats.

Original review:
Our cat's love this. The toys are really cute and well-made. Our oldest is VERY particular and only likes felt/wool blend toys. She actually plays with the toys from this box. Our kitten likes the wand toy. Nice to not have to scrounge around in stores looking and guessing. Kitties like getting new toys, I like staying out of stores!
label: negative
